list: The official 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze. Names, descriptions and grades are shown as PlayStation publishes them, matching the lists carried by Exophase and PSNProfiles (reported by Push Square, citing Exophase, 18 November 2026). Rockstar has not published its own list. Every guide below is written for this entry in its own words; a source is cited beside each guide, never copied.
roadmapNote: PowerPyx rates the set 4/10 and about 200 hours to the Platinum, one playthrough, no mission replay and no difficulty settings. GTABase agrees: around 200 hours, one playthrough, everything single-player. The only trophy either guide flags as possibly missable is Positive Mental Attitude. Cheats switch trophies and saving off, so keep them off for the whole run.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.guide: The Platinum is the last trophy you earn: it pops the moment the other 54 are all done. Nothing in the list needs online play or DLC, so a single offline playthrough is enough. Work through the roadmap in order and this one takes care of itself.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Earn the other 54 trophies.
No online play or DLC is needed.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed: it unlocks when you finish Gone Fishing, the first main mission of Chapter 1. Just play the opening and it pops on its own.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to the end.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed: finish every main mission in Chapter 1. It pops as Chapter 2 begins. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the one thing that might not come back: the balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude (see that trophy).
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Finish all Chapter 1 main missions.
Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation first — see Positive Mental Attitude.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed: finish every main mission in Chapter 2. This is the chapter where partner play opens up (after the Coffee Break mission), so most of the partner trophies become possible from here on.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Finish all Chapter 2 main missions.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed: finish every main mission in Chapter 3. Along the way this chapter unlocks the jewelry jobs, Randy's car wish list and the Dye Pack Jammer, which feed several later trophies.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Finish all Chapter 3 main missions.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed: finish every main mission in Chapter 4. This chapter also opens the big bank-vault robberies, which are the gateway to Maximum Withdrawal and A Classic Blitz Play.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Finish all Chapter 4 main missions.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed: finish the final mission and the credits roll. There is no mission replay, so keep a manual save from just before the finale — the game has 15 manual save slots, and PowerPyx recommends a save at the start and end of every chapter.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Finish the final mission.
Keep a manual save from before the finale.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed: complete the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks as part of normal story progress.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Complete the mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed: complete the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. It unlocks as part of normal story progress.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed: complete the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. It unlocks as part of normal story progress.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Complete the mission Child's Play in Chapter 4.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed: complete the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. It unlocks as part of normal story progress.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Complete the mission Headliners in Chapter 4.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed: complete the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown. It unlocks as part of normal story progress, and the airport setting is the same one Catch Me If You Can uses in free roam.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed: complete the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. It unlocks as part of normal story progress.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5.

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy, and the long one: finish the 100% Completion Checklist, which appears after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on the checklist is missable — everything can be done in free roam after the credits. The bar is lenient, roughly 60% true completion: most side quests are not needed, and of the things that are, you usually only need most of them — scan any 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles, study any 100 of the 255 animals through binoculars, and finish any 70 of the 80 challenges. The only tasks that need everything are the robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Do 100 optional missions along the way (there are far more than 100) and the bulk of the checklist fills itself.
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Finish the story, then open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Scan 200 of 277 vehicles and study 100 of 255 animals.
Complete 70 of the 80 challenges.
Finish every robbery, bank vault, gang operation, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest.

trophies.guide: Pull off any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game — the four kinds are 130 stunt jumps off ramps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps with a parachute, and you can mix them freely. Flying under bridges is the quickest way to rack them up. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250. Track progress by region under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and on the map under Exploration, then Stunt Spots.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Do any 250 stunts across the four categories.
Under-the-bridge flights are the fastest.
Keep going to 300 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check what you have done under Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities, and filter the map for Activities (the blue dumbbell icon) to find the rest. Most of them happen on their own while you work on the other trophies.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Do one of each of the 9 activity types.
Check Progress > Activities to see which are left.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting range challenges, spread across 12 shooting range locations. The golds are not too hard, and the ranges also level up your Focus, which helps with Gunslinger. PowerPyx has a separate page mapping all 12 ranges and all 42 gold medals — follow that for the exact spots.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Find the 12 shooting range locations.
Gold all 42 challenges.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — there are 42 drone races in total, so you only need one win per location, not every race. The drone races are also required in full for the 100% checklist, so this trophy comes on the way to A Long Road. PowerPyx maps all 14 locations.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Win one Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race location counts once, and there are 40 unique race locations to choose from, so you can skip the ones you find hardest. Races also count toward the activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Win 20 different races out of the 40 race locations.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you about a fishing spot, marked with a purple icon on the map. Follow his fishing questline and beat him in the fishing challenge it leads to.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui.
Follow Cal's text to the marked fishing spot.
Beat Cal in the fishing challenge.

trophies.guide: Finish any one of the four arcade games, called Video Games in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. You have to reach the end of the game — you do not need to beat every challenge inside it. Pick whichever you like best.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Play one of the four arcade games to the end.
The first three are on the TV at home; the fourth is on arcade machines.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's questline is Lucia-only and starts in Chapter 3: while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address in Belville, which marks the questline on the map. All five of her quests stay available after the story, so there is no rush. Finish the chain — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, then Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops at the end.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: As Lucia in Chapter 3, answer Andy's call.
Complete her five quests in order, ending with Puff Puff Pass.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline is marked automatically in Chapter 1: a while after the mission Island Dreams he calls you, and his green KR icon appears in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks — he marks purple chest icons on the map, you dig the treasure up with the metal detector and bring it back. After each set he calls you back with more locations. Track it under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees. Kenton goes away for a stretch in Chapter 1 but comes back in Chapters 2 to 3 (as Jason, calling Brian speeds it up), and everything is still doable after the story.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: Start Kenton's questline in Chapter 1 after Island Dreams.
Clear all 7 shipwreck treasure dives and return each haul.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County, and it all stays available after the story. Run his five jobs in order — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, then Hometown Heroes — and the trophy pops at the end.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: After Chapter 2's Coffee Break, go to the Thrillbilly Mudclub.
Complete Billy's five jobs, ending with Hometown Heroes.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands — but only certain questlines count. Confirmed to count: Kirk (the Skunk Ape hunts), Kyle (the farm chemicals), Yago (the street racing mentorship) and Pilot Pete (the delivery runs). Questlines for Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this one. Everything is still findable in free roam after the story, and the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows how many strands you have finished.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Complete 8 counting stranger strands.
Confirmed: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete.
Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's questline, Randy's Wish List, is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City) — the Zorrusso is already delivered by the mission, so 15 more to go. He marks some cars for you in fixed spots, but you can also steal them off the street; scan a car with the WAiNK app first to check whether it is on his list, and deliver it in good condition for more money. Sports cars are common around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach. Track the list under Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List. It can all be done after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Unlock Randy's Wish List in Chapter 3.
Deliver the 16 sports cars he wants (Zorrusso is already done).

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's questline is Jason-only and starts after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers appear for the Synthetic Labs in Vice City. Go and destroy the labs in the Take Out Kitty Litter quest, and once enough are gone Tyrone hands you his second quest, Spin On This, which ends the chain and pops the trophy. It all stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: As Jason after Here, Kitty Kitty, destroy the Synthetic Labs.
Complete Tyrone's second quest, Spin On This.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: The one trophy the guides flag as possibly missable — do it early and carefully. There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations, and you can meditate as both Jason and Lucia at each one, which counts double. Track them under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. The risk is in Chapter 1: after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, walks out to the balcony, and you follow her and choose Accept. That meditation adds +1 to the counter but is not marked as a spot like the others, so it is still unconfirmed whether it is required; PowerPyx did it and then earned the trophy, so do it to be safe. After Chapter 1 it is gone for good. You cannot finish the last meditation until both characters can play together, after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 are needed, but the trophy itself wants every spot.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: In Chapter 1, after Down to Earth, do Lucia's balcony meditation.
Meditate at all 18 spots, with both Jason and Lucia.
Track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's questline is Jason-only and starts after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret that marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. He then marks hunting spots with purple icons — hunt the animals he asks for and bring them back to him. On the first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, which you can pick up again from any weapon locker at an Ammu-Nation. A clean single shot keeps the animal pristine and pays more, but it is not required. Track the hunts under Map, then Activities, then Target Deck — there are 15 Target Decks, and all 15 are needed for the 100% checklist. Which exact animal pops the trophy is still being confirmed.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: As Jason after Coffee Break, answer Bret's text.
Hunt the animals he marks and bring them back.

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. Card packs are scattered across Leonida — there are 18 sets in total, so you only need three of them finished. PowerPyx maps every card set location; pick the three sets whose cards are closest together and work through them one set at a time.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Find card packs across Leonida.
Complete any 3 of the 18 card sets.

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to scan 100 locations — any 100 will do, there are far more than that. Hold Up and then R1 to scan what you are looking at. The scannable things fall into groups: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags. Scanning also feeds Whip It Good, so do both together while you explore.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Open the WAiNK app and scan landmarks, curiosities and sculptures.
Any 100 locations count.

trophies.guide: Finish any 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70, so this trophy pops on the way there. View and track them under Progress, then Challenges — a checkmark in the bottom right shows what is done. Most challenges complete on their own while you chase the other trophies, so leave this one for late in the run and then pick the easiest ones left.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges.
Keep going to 70 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Once partner play unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, call your partner over (hold Right, then press Triangle), build up a 4-star wanted level by causing trouble, then escape the red heat zone. A fast sports bike helps you cut through traffic, and shooting down a pursuing helicopter keeps it off you. The easiest escape PowerPyx found is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — police struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you there. The trophy pops when you drive out of the heat zone, not just out of the flashing search area. It also tends to pop on its own during the Chapter 4 bank-vault mission, since those robberies always trigger a 4-star wanted level.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: Call your partner, then reach a 4-star wanted level.
Escape the red heat zone — the Ambrosia train tunnel works well.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops in a row while staying wanted the whole time — you need to keep the flashing red-and-blue wanted level, not let it drop and not let it rise into the red heat level. Call your partner (hold Right, then press Triangle), then hit 3 robbery targets, the green icons on the map, one after another. Bring an armored vest and sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation, plus healing items. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, which open up after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — loot a few items in each store and break the back-room safe with sticky bombs. The unlock is delayed by about half a minute after you leave the third shop, and if it does not pop, hit a fourth shop and keep going.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: Call your partner and stay wanted throughout.
Rob 3 shops in a row — the north Vice City jewelry stores work well.
Wait ~30 seconds after the third shop; hit a fourth if it does not pop.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — scanning them with the WAiNK app is enough, you do not need to drive them. Hold Up to open WAiNK instantly, look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it. The fastest way is to stand on a busy road and scan everything that drives past. There are 557 vehicles at launch, and the 100% checklist wants 200 base models scanned, so this trophy comes naturally on the way. Check your totals under Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app — no need to drive them.
A busy road gives you 100 discoveries fast.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop 5 enemies inside one use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming — time slows and weak spots are highlighted, but it only lasts a few seconds and drains the purple focus bar. Prepare first: top up your focus with food and drinks or a wash at home, take Adrenaline to stretch the slowdown, wear body armor so you can step out of cover, and use an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. Line up 5 enemies before you trigger it — the criminals at gang operations are good targets — and do not miss. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so it gets easier late in the game.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Buff focus with food, drinks and Adrenaline.
Line up 5 gang enemies, then trigger Combat Focus (L3 + R3).
Drop all 5 before the slowdown ends.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the big passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at VCIA, Vice City International Airport — it has to be a plane connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not one sitting out on the airfield. The easiest is the plane at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head straight for it, and use the stairs by the boarding bridge, whose door leads right into the plane (or walk in through the terminal). Get in, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse the plane to the runway, take off and fly at least 1 km away from the airport — the trophy is a little delayed, so keep flying until it pops.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Go to VCIA and take the plane docked at terminal E3/E4.
Reverse to the runway, take off and fly 1 km from the airport.

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. The Rhinos are parked in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive in through the gate, or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb into a tank and start shooting enemies until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station in Mariana County.
Enter a Rhino tank in the south of the base and shoot enemies.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — that unlocks the Snap Gun for silently picking alarmed doors, and marks jewelry store robberies with green icons on the map. Then break into a store through the back door using the Snap Gun: when you reach a locked door you get the choice to kick it (which trips the alarm) or use the Snap Gun for the quiet way in. The Snap Gun stays in your inventory permanently, no need to equip it. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code and use it to loot the safe. A good spot is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3.
Enter a jewelry store's back door with the Snap Gun.
Find the safe code note and loot the safe undetected.

trophies.guide: Rob any 5 bank vaults and get away. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe), which is marked automatically from story progress: you tail a security van until it stops at a bank, a guard carries a briefcase of cash inside and the vault opens — slip in while it is open and rob it, bringing your partner along to carry a second bag. After that mission, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip about security vans (you need his earlier Payday Loans quests done first) and he marks the vans with a purple icon. There are 8 large bank jobs in total and the 100% checklist wants all 8, so this trophy comes on the way. Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and then switch vehicles to shake the heat. A single vault can pay up to $205,000.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Finish That's Where The Money Is… in Chapter 4.
Follow security vans to banks and rob the open vaults.
Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank jobs and escape.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It happens automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — the same mission that opens bank-vault robberies — because tailing the truck to a bank and robbing its vault counts. To get it earlier, find an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, block its path, stick a bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius (a Pay 'n' Spray helps). Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop once you have done his quests.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Do the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…, or
Blow open a roaming armored truck with a sticky bomb and escape the heat.

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map of Leonida — all 52 areas. The quickest way is by plane: fly over every patch of black fog until the entire map is revealed. PowerPyx has a guide to the best plane and route for unfogging fast.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Take a plane and fly over every fogged area.
Keep going until no black fog is left on the map.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total, and the 100% checklist wants all of them, so this trophy comes on the way. Operations are marked with yellow icons on the map when you get near them, and many are marked automatically as the story progresses. Track each gang's count under Progress, then Gangs.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs.
Keep going — the 100% checklist needs all 39.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet, as of 19 November 2026: PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, and GTA Zone counts it among the five trophies neither PowerPyx nor GTABase has pinned down. The description points at a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, so the likely spot is a bar or venue overlooking the beach — but treat that as a guess, not a confirmed step, until a guide verifies it. Check the linked guides again after launch week.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: No confirmed steps yet — listed as unknown by PowerPyx and GTABase.
The description suggests Ocean Beach; wait for a verified method.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet, as of 19 November 2026: PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, and GTA Zone counts it among the five trophies neither PowerPyx nor GTABase has pinned down. The description suggests driving a car out through a vehicle showroom's glass front — a nod to the classic GTA showroom escape — but that is a guess from the wording, not a verified step. Check the linked guides again after launch week.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: No confirmed steps yet — listed as unknown by PowerPyx and GTABase.
The description suggests a showroom smash-out; wait for a verified method.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. Bring sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation first — you need them to blow the safe. The three items: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway. You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, which is marked automatically. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item, and killing the enemies is not needed. If you miss an item during the mission, do not worry: the robbery icon respawns after a while, so you can go back and take what is left. It is not missable.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Buy sticky bombs at an Ammu-Nation.
At Kingpin Bowling, take the watch, the Gutterball shotgun and the safe.
Escape the police — the trophy pops on escape.

trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. You can only start once you can switch between both characters, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Check your Strength level under Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, then the character, then Strength (the heart icon). Raise it by working out — buy a fitness club membership, and always go together with your partner (hold Right, then press Triangle to call them): while one character actively works out, the other finishes their training automatically, so you progress twice as fast. Filter the map for fitness clubs under Activities (the dumbbell icon). You can also work out at home after the story.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: After Coffee Break, work out with both characters together.
Raise both to maximum Strength at the same time.

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile — the game tracks the count, and you can see how many of 500 you have done by opening the trophy in the trophy list. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications first (Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile), so a small demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever something you do moves your reputation. Your profile shifts between Professional (stealthy objectives, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent (killing), Psycho (mass killing, driving over gravestones) and Irredeemable — which is permanent, so avoid piling on excessive violence. Most of the 500 come passively from robberies and fights while you chase the other trophies; if you are still short at the end, PowerPyx notes it can be farmed quickly, but keep an eye on the Irredeemable warning.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

steps: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings > UI.
Play normally — robberies and encounters count toward 500.
Avoid reaching the permanent Irredeemable profile.

trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet, as of 19 November 2026: PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. The description — second time's the charm — suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt, but that is only the belief PowerPyx reports, not a verified step. Check the linked guides again after launch week.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: No confirmed steps yet — listed as unknown by PowerPyx.
Believed to involve the Payday Loans store from the prologue.

trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet, as of 19 November 2026: PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be from a UFO questline. The description — what the hell just happened? — fits a strange encounter, but that is only the belief PowerPyx reports, not a verified step. Check the linked guides again after launch week.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: No confirmed steps yet — listed as unknown by PowerPyx.
Believed to come from a UFO questline.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet, as of 19 November 2026: PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle — a melee drive-by, as the description says. That is only the belief PowerPyx reports, not a verified step, so treat the motorcycle-kick idea as a lead to test rather than a confirmed method. Check the linked guides again after launch week.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: No confirmed steps yet — listed as unknown by PowerPyx.
Believed to involve kicking enemies from a moving motorcycle.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts — it counts across all your robberies, not in one go. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. It comes naturally while you do the robberies for the 100% checklist, and a single bank vault can hold up to $205,000, though vaults only open after the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is….
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Finish Credit Check in Chapter 3 to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer.
Deliver $250,000 in marked bills to a fence in total.

trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all types of shops. The fastest way is the expensive stuff: guns, car mods and tattoos. The shops around Leonida include 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores — buy what you actually want and the total adds up on its own.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Spend $100,000 in total across any shops.
Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way there.

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages, for $160,000 in total — the 4 story-related garages do not count toward this one. Garages go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses): you get a notification that the Vice City Real Estate app has been installed on your phone, and you buy the garages through that app. Robberies are the quickest way to earn the money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3 and 4. Buying garages also adds the parking spots you need to register vehicles for On the Spot.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: After Daily Driver in Chapter 2, open the Vice City Real Estate app.
Buy all 8 purchasable garages ($160,000 total).

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app, which is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). The app lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to you anywhere. First buy enough garages (see Little Boxes), because each garage adds parking spots for registered vehicles. Then drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray and then Register in his garage. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep it down.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Buy garages first for the parking spots.
Drive 10 stolen vehicles to Moses and choose Respray, then Register.
